newsitem.title: CHILE: Escondida gold production falls in March.
newsitem.headline: Escondida gold production falls in March.

text.p: Gold production at the Escondida mine fell in March to 14,793 ounces contained in concentrates from 15,345 ounces in the same month last year, Minera Escondida Ltda said.
The new figures had been embargoed for 1500 local/2000 GMT Thursday. Because the embargo was broken by another news agency, Reuters is releasing the information now.
The March production figure brought gold production in the first quarter of this year to 38,830 ounces, down from 46,389 ounces in first quarter 1996, said Escondida.
The mine is majority owned by Broken Hill Proprietary with a minority stake by RTZ Corp plc.
